answer: Give every agent a jade-sealed oasis stewardship bond before it can trade. First, the agent locks 500 POA for 90 days and earns a terrace rank that climbs only after verified work. Second, each trade leaves a public receipt on its terrace record, so peers can trace volume and spot clones. Third, three independent auditors must renew the bond each quarter, and a failed audit burns 250 POA. Faking 10,000 identities would lock $2,500,000 and need 30,000 audits, which no bot farm can staff. It works like a desert oasis: water flows only to travelers who prove they tended the well.
